editorial:
If you're in the mood for a loud, fast, and slightly silly action ride, this one delivers. James Reese is a young guy working as an ambassador's aide in Paris who dreams of becoming a real CIA agent. His wish comes true when he gets paired with Charlie Wax, a wild and trigger-happy operative played by John Travolta. The two couldn't be more different, and that odd-couple energy drives most of the fun. Expect gunfights, car chases, and plenty of explosions as they chase down a terrorist plot across the city.

Travolta clearly has a blast playing the over-the-top Wax, and his energy keeps things moving even when the story gets thin. The action scenes are big and loud, though some of the effects and editing feel a bit dated. The plot doesn't always make sense, but you probably won't care if you just want a popcorn movie. It's best for fans of buddy-cop action who don't mind turning off their brain. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, James learns that his girlfriend Caroline is actually part of the terrorist cell they've been hunting. She tries to kill him, but Charlie saves the day. The big twist is that Caroline was using James to get close to the ambassador. After a shootout, James shoots Caroline to stop her. Charlie and James walk away as partners, with James finally becoming a real agent. It's a bittersweet ending that shows James has grown tougher.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves buddy-cop action movies with big explosions.
